mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies with temperatures around 64 degrees as we look out toward Badger Ridge Middle School under a third quarter moon.

We have plenty going on, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, followed by farmer's market fun on October 7.
A notable incident occurred on September 28 when a 71-year-old Madison man was cited for a two-vehicle rear-end crash on CTH-PB at CTH-M.
